$Comment: What each step of Santa's Christmas story pays, from Present Thieves to Wrapping Presents. Every roll
is read on its own: the first always pays, the second is a chance on top. Chance is a percent from 0
The first roll pays Christmas Coins, the season's own currency that the four Christmas stalls take,
and festival tokens, the currency every season shares, both through the Currency reward kind (a
counter wallet has no item to hand over), with a couple of the game's candy canes for the road. Favor
on Santa's Nice List and Festival Favor are not here: each quest pays them on its own Rewards, so the
quest card shows them. A companion mod adds rolls of its own with a file that names this table in
ContributesTo, so nothing here has to change.
Name: Christmas_Chain_Pay
